textwithimage.text:
Based on TQMx50UC Intel® Core™ i3/i5/i7 5000U (Gen. 5)

The Embedded Starterkit STKx50UC is an evaluation kit tailored to the needs of embedded computing engineers. Built upon the TQMx50UC platform and powered by Intel® Core™ i3/i5/i7 5000U (Gen. 5) processors, this kit boasts exceptional CPU and graphics performance. Equipped with a TQMx86 board controller offering customized expansion options through flexiCFG, it stands out with its best-in-class performance per Watt (15W TDP). With features like up to 16 GB DDR3L onboard memory, a highly precise industrial real-time clock (iRTC), and a comprehensive uEFI BIOS with Easy-Config, Multi-Setup, and Touch support, this kit ensures high functional reliability, making it suitable for 24/7 certified applications.

text.text:
Features

  • Customizable Expansion: Utilize the TQMx86 board controller for flexible and customized expansion options.
  • Superior Energy Efficiency: Achieves remarkable performance per Watt with a 15W TDP.
  • Onboard Memory: Supports up to 16 GB DDR3L onboard memory for efficient data handling.
  • Precision Timekeeping: Features a very precise industrial real-time clock (iRTC).
  • Robust uEFI BIOS: Comes with a comprehensive uEFI BIOS featuring Easy-Config, Multi-Setup, and Touch support.

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel® Core™ 5000U series (Broadwell-U)
  • i7-5650U: 2x 2.2 GHz/3.2 GHz Turbo, 4 MB Cache, HD6000
  • i5-5350U: 2x 1.8 GHz/2.9 GHz Turbo, 3 MB Cache, HD6000
  • i3-5010U: 2x 2.1 GHz, 3 MB Cache, HD5500
  • Celeron® 3765U: 2x 1.9GHz/no Turbo, 2MB Cache, 5th Gen HD graphics
  • Hyper-Threading and Virtualization support
Memory
  • DDR3L - 4-16 Gb
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 2x Digital Display Interface/DP++ with up to 4K @ 60 Hz
  • LVDS Interface (18/24-bit, Single/Dual Channel), up to 4K (optional eDP 1.3 with 4 lanes instead of LVDS)
  • Intel® Quick Sync Video and Wireless Display support
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbit Ethernet
  • USB - 8x USB 2.0 | 2x USB 3.0
  • Serial Ports: 2x Serial port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 4x PCIe 2.0
  • LPC - LPC bus
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • GPIO - 8x GPIOthrough TQ-flexiCFG
  • SATA - 4x SATA Gen3
General
  • Dimensions - 95mm x 95mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Compact, Type 6
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C 
  • Power supply - 8.5 V - 20 V / 5 V Standby (optional) / 3 V battery/GoldCAP on carrier (optional)
  • Power consumption - Power: typ. 10 W/max. 18 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
